chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, all together from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Ri'ab, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Whenever God, Mighty and Majestic, intends to create the seed (nutfa) regarding which He took the covenant in the loins of Adam — or whatever He wills concerning it — and to place it in the womb, He stirs the man toward intercourse, and He reveals to the womb: 'Open your door so that My creation may enter you, and My irrevocable decree and My power [may be carried out].'

So the womb opens its door, and the seed reaches the womb and circulates within it for forty days. Then it becomes a clot ('alaqa) for forty days. Then it becomes a lump (mudgha) for forty days. Then it becomes flesh through which intertwined veins run. Then God sends two creative angels who create in the wombs whatever God wills. They enter into the belly of the woman through the woman's mouth, and reach the womb, in which is the ancient spirit that has been transferred through the loins of men and the wombs of women. They breathe into it the spirit of life and continuity, and they cleave open for it hearing, sight, and all the limbs, and everything in the belly, by God's permission.

Then God reveals to the two angels: 'Write upon him My decree and My predestination and My binding command, and stipulate for Me the possibility of change (bada') in what you write.' They say: 'O Lord! What shall we write?' So God reveals to them both: 'Raise your heads toward the head of his mother.' They raise their heads, and the Tablet is striking the forehead of his mother. They look into it and find in the Tablet his image, his adornment, his appointed term, and his covenant — whether he is wretched or fortunate — and all his affairs.

He said: So one of them dictates to his companion, and they both write down all that is in the Tablet, and stipulate the possibility of change (bada') in what they write. Then they seal the document and place it between his eyes. Then they stand him upright in the belly of his mother.

He said: Perhaps he is obstinate and turns over — and that happens only with every obstinate or rebellious one. When the time comes for the child to emerge, complete or incomplete, God, Mighty and Majestic, reveals to the womb: 'Open your door so that My creature may come out to My earth and My command may be carried out in him — for his time of exit has come.'

He said: So the womb opens its door for the child. God sends to him an angel called Zajir (the Rebuker). He rebukes him with a single rebuke, and the child is startled by it and turns over: his feet come to be above his head and his head at the lower part of the belly — so that God may make the exit easy for the woman and for the child. He said: If he tarries, the angel rebukes him again, and he is startled by it, and the child falls to the earth crying, frightened from the rebuke.

key_terms.الرُّوحُ الْقَدِيمَة: The ancient/primordial spirit — the pre-existing soul transferred through successive generations in loins and wombs
key_terms.النُّطْفَة: The sperm/seed — here carrying the soul covenanted before Adam's creation
key_terms.الْبَدَاء: Bada' — the Shia theological doctrine of God's alteration of pre-written destiny; the angels are instructed to stipulate this possibility
key_terms.الْمِيثَاق: The primordial covenant (mithaq), when all souls pledged monotheism before Adam
key_terms.زَاجِر: Zajir — the angel of rebuke who causes the fetal position to flip and initiates the birth cry

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir say about how God creates human beings in the womb?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) describes, in a cosmological narrative, the complete process of human creation from the divine decision to create a soul through embryological development to birth. The hadith reveals that God first stirs the man toward intercourse, commands the womb to receive, and then stages the embryo through sperm (40 days), clot (40 days), and lump (40 days) phases before flesh with veins forms. Two angelic creators then enter, breathe the soul into the embryo, and receive divine revelation to write the full decree of the child's life — read from a Tablet upon the mother's forehead — including whether the child will be wretched or fortunate. The doctrine of bada' (divine alteration of destiny) is explicitly embedded in the angels' recording. The birth itself is facilitated by the angel Zajir, whose rebuke causes the fetus to turn head-down, and whose second rebuke at birth causes the newborn's cry.
word_analysis: so that He may make easy

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, both together from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whenever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Intends to Create the seed from which He<sup>azwj</sup> would Take the Covenant against in the ribs of Adam<sup>as</sup>, or whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> would be Managing for him with regards to it, and Makes it to be in the womb, Stirs the man for the copulation, or Reveals unto the womb: “Open your door until My<sup>azwj</sup> Creation resides inside you and My<sup>azwj</sup> Ordainment and My<sup>azwj</sup> Power is implemented”. 
So the womb opens up its door, so the seed sails into the womb. So it vibrates inside it for forty days, then becomes a clot for forty days; then it becomes a lump for forty days; then it becomes flesh with veins flowing inside it entangled. Then Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sends two creating Angels who create in the wombs whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires. So they both storm into the belly of the woman from the mouth of the woman. So they both arrive to the womb, and in it is the spirit from old (from before), the one transferred in the ribs of the men and the wombs of the women. So they both blow into it a soul of life, and the remaining, and cleave open for him the hearing, and the sight, and the entirety of the body parts, and the entire of whatever is in the belly, by the Permission of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>.
Then Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Reveals to the two Angels: “Write upon him My<sup>azwj</sup> Ordainment, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Pre-determination, and implement My<sup>azwj</sup> Command, and stipulate for Me<sup>azwj</sup> the change regarding what you two are writing”. So they both say: ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! What should we write?’ So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Reveals unto them both: “Raise both your heads to the head of its mother”. So they both raise their heads, and there is a Tablet upon the forehead of its mother. So they both look into it, and they find (written) in the Tablet, its image, and its adornment, and its term, and its Covenant whether it is miserable or fortunate, and the entirety of its affairs’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So one of them dictates to his companion, so they both write down the entirety of whatever is in the Tablet, and the change is stipulated upon both of them with regards to what they write. Then they both seal the document and make it to be between his eyes. Then they both make it stand straight in the belly of its mother’. 
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So perhaps he is haughty (arrogant), so he turns over, and that does not happen except regarding every haughty or insolent one. When the time reaches, the child comes out complete, or other than complete. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Reveals unto the womb: “Open your door until My<sup>azwj</sup> creature comes out to My<sup>azwj</sup> earth, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Command gets implemented regarding him”. So the time has reached and the child comes out.
So the womb opens its door of the birth. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sends an Angel called Zajir (Rebuker) to him. So he rebukes him with such a rebuke that the child panics from it, so he overturns and his feet come to be above its head, and its head in the lower part of the belly, in order for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> to Make it easy upon the woman and upon the child, for the exiting’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So when the rebuke of the Angel is withheld, he rebukes it again, so it panics from it, and the child falls to the ground crying, having panicked from the rebuke’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father all from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, wants to create the seed which has formed the covenant when taken from the back of Adam or what appears to Him, (due to al-Bada’ ) He places it in the womb and moves the man to go to bed with the woman (his wife). He inspires the womb to open its door so that His creature can enter in it and His authoritative determination and measure.

The womb opens its door and the seed reaches the womb, then turns back and forth for forty days, then it becomes a clot, then an embryo in forty days, then a piece of flesh in which veins spread like a net. Then Allah sends two creative angels in the womb who make in the womb as Allah wills. They enter inside the woman through her mouth until they reach her womb. In it (the seed) is the old spirit transferred from the backs of men to the wombs of women, then they blow in it the spirit of life and continued life and carve for him ears, eyes, all of his parts and all the inside by the permission of Allah.

Then Allah sends revelation to the two angels that says, ‘Write upon him My authoritative command of determination and measures and stipulate for me a change of plan (al- bada’) in what you write.’ They then ask, ‘What must we write, O Lord?’ Allah then reveals to them to raise their heads to the head of his mother.’ They then raise their heads and find a tablet knocking [informing] from the forehead of his mother. They look at it and find in it his shape, fashion, duration of his life, his covenant of being a virtuous or a wicked one and all of his characteristics.’

He (the Imam) then said, ‘One of them dictates, the other writes all that is in the tablet and stipulates the condition of change of plan (al-bada’). They seal the book and place it between his two eyes, then they make him stand up in the belly of his mother.’

He (the Imam) said, ‘He perhaps turns insolent and changes and this only happens with insolent and disobedient ones. When it is time for his coming out Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, inspires the womb to open its door so that His creature can come out to His earth so that His command is applied to him; it is time for him to come out.’

He (the Imam) then said, ‘The womb then opens the door of the child and Allah sends an angel called a reprimanding one, who reprimands him and it makes him feel shocked. His head turns downward and his feet upward thus Allah makes it easy for the child to come out as well as for the woman.’ He (the Imam) then said, ‘When he stops the angel reproaches him again which gives him a shock again. He then falls on the ground crying and upset because of the reproach.’”
